name: empiriolabs
description: Agent skills for EmpirioLabs AI: ask text models for answers and second opinions, generate and edit images, make videos, build 3D models, compose music and sound effects, turn text into speech, transcribe audio and video, read documents as Markdown, search the web, and choose models and prices from the live catalog.

interface.longDescription: Ten skills that let an agent use EmpirioLabs AI: ask text models for answers and second opinions, generate and edit images, make videos from a prompt or a start image, build 3D models from a picture, compose music and sound effects, turn text into speech, transcribe audio and video files, read PDFs and images as Markdown, search the web with sources, and choose models with their prices from the live catalog. Each skill runs a small Python script that uses only the standard library and saves results to the path you choose. Every skill except the model catalog needs an EmpirioLabs AI API key in EMPIRIOLABS_API_KEY, and requests are billed to your EmpirioLabs AI account at each model's listed price. The model catalog skill needs no key.
